messages.content: You are a careful, fair evaluator.

You are grading a support assistant's reply for Northwind Outdoor (an outdoor-gear and bike store). Judge a SINGLE failure mode only and ignore every other way the reply might be good or bad.

FAILURE MODE: MISSED REQUIRED FACT (missing_required_fact, NO-CONTEXT ablation)
Definition: the reply fails to convey a key fact the customer explicitly asked about, or a fact the resolved answer depends on. A factual error, a missing required number, a missing required confirmation, or omitting the core answer = FAIL. Correct and complete coverage of every required fact = PASS.

IMPORTANT (ablation): NO handbook context is provided for this one. You can only see that a context section existed, but NOT its text. Judge the missed-fact mode using only the ticket and the reply (e.g. facts the reply itself must contain and its internal consistency).

Grade ONLY this failure mode for the reply below.

--- TICKET ---
Good morning, and thank you for your assistance. I am writing to you today because I am preparing to place my first order with Northwind Outdoor. I have been looking forward to purchasing some new camping gear for my upcoming trip, and I wanted to ensure that I am following all the correct procedures before I proceed. I noticed in your registration details that there is a specific requirement regarding email verification. Could you please confirm if I must complete this verification step within 24 hours of registering my account? I want to be absolutely certain that I do not inadvertently cause any issues with my account status, such as a suspension, by missing this deadline. I am not currently experiencing any problems, but I prefer to be well-informed and organized before taking any action. Your clarification would be greatly appreciated, as it will help me feel more confident in moving forward with my purchase. Thank you very much for your time and for the excellent service your team provides. I look forward to hearing from you soon.

--- HANDBOOK CONTEXT ---
(section ids were recalled but their text is intentionally withheld in this ablation)

--- ASSISTANT REPLY ---
Yes, you must complete email verification within 24 hours of registering your account. If your email is not verified within this 24-hour window, your account will be automatically suspended [accounts].

To reactivate a suspended account, you can resend the verification link. However, please note that if the account remains unverified for 7 days, it will be permanently deleted, and any associated draft orders will be canceled [accounts].

--- GRADING EXAMPLES ---
(none: this is a zero-shot judge. Use only the definition above.)

Rules:
1. Consider only the MISSED REQUIRED FACT mode above; everything else is out of scope.
2. Be strict and fair exactly as the definition states.
3. Verdict "fail" only if a required fact is clearly missing or wrong.

Respond with JSON only:
{"critique": "<one short sentence citing the evidence>", "verdict": "pass" or "fail"}
